project.title: French Craving-Control Claymation Ad
project.goal: Create a 30-second French-language claymation ad for an evening craving-control ritual drink for women who train, framed around ritual and control without medical or weight-loss claims.

product_intake.what_it_is: An evening ritual drink for women who train and want to stay in control of evening cravings.
product_intake.who_it_serves: Women who train regularly but struggle with evening cravings.
product_intake.core_benefit: A calming evening ritual that helps you stay in control and aligned with your training goals.
claim_constraints: No medical, weight-loss, or guaranteed appetite-suppression claims.
Frame around ritual, support, evening routine, control, and alignment with training goals.
Stronger claims only if explicitly verified and approved.

audience_psychology.persona: Lea, early 30s, trains four times a week, disciplined by day but ambushed by cravings in the evening.
audience_psychology.core_tension: She feels in control all day, then loses that control at night and feels she is undoing her own effort.
audience_psychology.trigger_moment: The quiet evening hour after training when fatigue and cravings arrive together.
audience_psychology.desired_identity: A woman who stays aligned with her goals without punishing herself.
objections: Fear of being shamed about food or body.

ad_concept.idea: The evening ritual that hands control back to her.
ad_concept.angle: Not a fix for her body, a ritual for her evening.
ad_concept.hook_premise: A bold claymation evening-ritual image that stops the scroll.

story_beats.purpose: Stop the scroll with a bold tactile claymation image of the evening ritual.
Show the emotional evening craving moment with empathy.
Introduce the drink as a calm, intentional ritual.
Show the shift back into control and alignment with training goals.
End on a clean tactile product hero shot.

main_subject.role: woman in her early 30s who trains regularly
main_subject.appearance: warm tactile claymation figure, athletic build, relaxed ponytail, expressive clay face
main_subject.wardrobe: fitted workout wear in muted warm tones, no visible logos

product.name: amber-colored craving-control ritual drink
product.shape: small rounded glass bottle with a soft cork-style cap
product.label: minimal unbranded label, no claims text
product.required_visibility: drink clearly visible in the ritual, shift, and hero beats

location.setting: warm home kitchen in the evening
location.background: wooden counter, soft cupboard, a wall clock, a gym bag
location.lighting: warm amber key light, soft evening shadows

camera_language.lens: intimate close and medium claymation framing
camera_language.movement: slow push-ins and gentle slides, no impossible moves

negative_constraints: no scales, calorie counts, or weight numbers
no live-action or photoreal style, claymation only

review_checklist: No medical, weight-loss, or appetite-suppression claims in any line or frame?
Is all copy and voiceover in French and natural for the French market?
Does the amber drink stay visually identical across clips?
Does the warm claymation style stay consistent?
Does the arc open on a scroll-stopper and end on a product hero?
Does each clip have one primary action?
Does total runtime equal the sum of clip durations?
